summary:

The consensus earnings estimate was $7.11 per share on revenue of $22.11 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $8.71 per share. "Revenue growth was driven by broad global consumer demand for Mounjaro and Zepbound, the global launches of Foundayo, expanded U.S. coverage for obesity care and a doubling in our newest products in oncology, immunology and neuroscience. To drive durable long-term growth, we continue to invest in our drug-making and technology capabilities, with multiple business development deals and partnerships signed and closed, and with new manufacturing expansions in Texas and Virginia. Lilly is executing well across the value chain, and our potential for impact on human health continues to expand."

Eli Lilly and Co is a drug manufacturing company. It discovers, develops, manufactures, and sells human pharmaceutical products and animal health products.
